opening.argument: The video provides practical Windows support: it explains how to create Windows installation media with a USB flash drive and first directs viewers to verify compatibility for the PC involved. The visual material reinforces that instructional purpose, showing device specifications, Windows 10 system requirements, Microsoft's download page, and setup selections for language, edition, and architecture. Its title identifies the subject as creating Windows 10 installation media as official Dell technical support, while the subscribe prompt and Dell social links reflect ordinary channel engagement and support contact information. Nothing presented establishes a financial offer, payment request, credential request, or deceptive transaction; the material is directed to compatibility checking and an operational installation process.

citations.quote: In this video we'll show you how to create windows installation media using a USB Flash Drive.
Before starting the process there are a few things to verify pertaining to compatibility for the PC on which Windows 10 will be installed.
How to Create Windows 10 Installation Media (Official Dell Tech Support)
